name: The Fourth Sister
summary: Once Morgantha is dead, a girl sells plain pastries on the miller's lane below Old Bonegrinder, and says her Granny is coming for her thirteenth birthday.

stages.journal: Vasile and Petre say Goodwife Sarnov walks up the miller's lane every morning for one plain pastry, from a girl who sells them there, and that the girl has her husband's eyes.
objectives: Find the girl on the miller's lane below Old Bonegrinder

stages.journal: A girl called Mouse sells plain pastries on the miller's lane. She calls Morgantha Mother, and says she's to be a sister when she's thirteen.
objectives: Find out what Mouse is waiting for

stages.journal: Mouse turns thirteen on the next dark night, when Morgantha's own mother, Granny Ash, comes out of the deep wood to make her a hag. The iron is already coming in at her gums.
objectives: Be at Mouse's hut on the miller's lane after dark
Optional: find out who Mouse was before she was Mouse

stages.journal: Granny Ash is dead in the miller's lane. Mouse is waiting by her hut.
Mouse is Zamfira Sarnov again, home with her mother, Ilka and Toma in the village. She makes plain pastries for Bildrath's, and nobody has dreamed anything yet.
Granny didn't finish what she started, and Mouse has grey teeth partway. Ilinca Vrana took her to the Keepers of the Feather, who have had odder members.
We gave Mouse to Granny Ash for a basket of coins and a hag's word never to come back to the valley.
